You are a software architect planning a major visual redesign of a Next.js 16 portfolio site (josephibrahim.com). Based on reference site analysis (Pentagram, Electric Theatre, Future Deluxe, Tendril, Found Studio), here are the changes needed. Design a detailed, phased implementation plan.

## Current State
- Dark theme (#141414), 4 fonts (Inter, DM Sans, Open Sans, Lora), golden ratio spacing
- 2-column staggered LadderGrid with scroll animations, hover-to-play video thumbnails
- Project detail page: hero video → metadata → description → collapsible "Project Details" → breakdowns → related work → prev/next nav
- VideoThumbnail: 60% opacity + desaturated at rest, full brightness on hover
- ProjectCard: title (Lora italic) + gridDescription + client below thumbnail
- 13 projects, all have lightingIntent, challenge, approach, reference, credits, technologies, responsibilities populated

## Target State (from references)
Design changes organized by priority:

### 1. Project Detail Page → Editorial Narrative (Tendril/Found model)
Current: flat metadata dump with collapsible details
Target: magazine-style editorial with narrative sections

New structure:
```
[PROJECT TYPE TAG]          -- small, uppercase, dim (keep existing)
[TITLE]                     -- change from Lora italic to Inter clean sans-serif
[METADATA: Year • Client • Studio]  -- keep existing
[MY ROLE + RESPONSIBILITIES] -- keep existing

[HERO VIDEO]                -- keep existing EmbeddedVideoPlayer

[DESCRIPTION]               -- make full-width, larger text, more editorial

[NARRATIVE SECTIONS - ALWAYS VISIBLE, NOT COLLAPSIBLE:]
  INTENT section heading + lightingIntent text
  CHALLENGE section heading + challenge text  
  APPROACH section heading + approach text
  REFERENCE section heading + reference text

[TECHNOLOGIES]              -- NEW: display as a clean inline list

[CREDITS]                   -- collapsible toggle (Tendril pattern)

[RELATED WORK]              -- upgrade: show 3 cards with thumbnails (Found pattern), not just text links
[NEXT PROJECT]              -- full-width thumbnail preview (Tendril pattern) replacing small prev/next text links
```

Key changes:
- Remove the collapsible "Project Details" toggle — show Intent/Challenge/Approach/Reference as always-visible editorial sections
- Each section gets an uppercase heading + body text, full-width, with generous spacing between
- Credits remain collapsible (Tendril pattern)
- Related work shows thumbnail cards instead of text-only links
- Next project becomes a prominent full-width card with thumbnail
- Remove prev project link (forward-only flow like Tendril)
- Section spacing: use --space-lg (89px) between major sections

### 2. Typography Consolidation (All references use 1 font)
Current: 4 fonts (Inter, DM Sans, Open Sans, Lora)
Target: Inter as primary for everything, Lora only for the homepage hero quote

Changes:
- layout.tsx: Remove DM_Sans import, keep Open_Sans only if needed as fallback
- ProjectCard title: change from Lora italic to Inter 400
- ProjectDetailContent title: change from Lora italic to Inter 400
- All body text: Inter instead of Open Sans
- Footer: Inter instead of DM Sans references
- Keep Lora ONLY for the homepage hero statement italic quote

### 3. Strip Card Chrome (Electric Theatre/Future Deluxe pattern)
Current: VideoThumbnail at 60% opacity, desaturated, with inset box-shadow
Target: Full brightness/saturation at rest, no inset shadows

Changes in VideoThumbnail.tsx:
- Remove `boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px #141414'` from both mobile and desktop
- Change resting opacity from 0.60 to 0.85 (subtle dim, not dramatic)
- Change resting filter from `saturate(0.6) brightness(0.85)` to `saturate(0.85) brightness(0.95)` (subtle, not washed out)
- Keep hover state at full 1.0 opacity and full saturation

### 4. Simplify Project Card Text (Electric Theatre pattern)
Current: title (Lora italic) + gridDescription + client
Target: title (Inter, clean) + client only. No description on grid.

Changes in ProjectCard.tsx:
- Remove gridDescription display from cards
- Title: Inter 400 (not Lora italic), slightly smaller
- Client: keep as small uppercase metadata below
- This makes cards cleaner and saves description for detail pages

### 5. Accent Color Discipline
Current: #d4a853 amber used in some places
Target: Reserve amber ONLY for hover/interactive states

Review globals.css and components for any static (non-hover) uses of --accent color and remove them.

### 6. Section Spacing Increase
Current: --space-lg (89px) between sections
Target: increase to 120px between major sections on project detail pages

Add a new CSS variable --space-section: 120px for project detail page section gaps.

## Implementation Order
1. Typography consolidation (layout.tsx, globals.css) — foundational, affects everything
2. Project detail page redesign (ProjectDetailContent.tsx) — biggest visual change
3. Strip card chrome (VideoThumbnail.tsx) — quick win
4. Simplify card text (ProjectCard.tsx) — quick win
5. Accent color audit (globals.css, components) — cleanup pass
6. Spacing tuning (globals.css) — final polish

## Files to modify:
- `app/layout.tsx` — remove DM Sans, adjust font usage
- `app/globals.css` — add --space-section, minor variable changes
- `components/ProjectDetailContent.tsx` — major rewrite to editorial layout
- `components/ProjectCard.tsx` — simplify to title + client only, Inter font
- `components/VideoThumbnail.tsx` — raise resting opacity/saturation, remove box-shadow
- `components/Footer.tsx` — check for DM Sans references

## Constraints:
- Do NOT touch LadderGrid.tsx stagger/scroll animation — keep the golden ratio grid
- Do NOT touch Navigation.tsx
- Do NOT touch the perception system
- Do NOT touch HeroReel or homepage hero statement (keep Lora italic there)
- Keep all existing functionality (hover-to-play, scroll animations, view transitions)
- Keep dark theme (#141414)
- This is a VISUAL ONLY redesign — no new features, no data model changes

Provide a detailed implementation plan with specific code changes per file.
